female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

loan-history-interaction.title: Mentioning a history of successful loan repayments has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
loan-history-interaction.body: While referencing successful previous loan cycles accelerates funding for women, it is associated with slower funding for men.

female-stability-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe institutional or physical stability, such as training or a permanent location, may fund faster.

female-gratitude-faster.body: Female borrowers who include an explicit expression of gratitude to lenders may fund faster.

female-labor-costs-slower.body: Female borrowers who specifically mention labor costs in their pitches may fund more slowly.

templated-text-slower-general.body: The use of templated or nearly identical phrasing in pitches may predict slower funding regardless of gender.

male-personal-details-faster.body: Male borrowers who include personal details about family size and housing may fund faster.

male-children-ages-faster.body: Male borrowers who include the specific ages of their children may fund faster.

male-education-purpose-interaction.body: Male borrowers focusing on children's school costs may fund faster than those focusing on their own university tuition.

female-family-details-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention children and spouse may fund more slowly.

female-borrower-age-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-specificity-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a specific administrative district or region may fund more slowly.

female-specific-challenges-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific challenges like weather or input costs may fund faster.
female-specific-challenges-faster.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new observations.

female-food-security-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention increasing household food security may fund faster.

female-descriptive-inputs-slower.title: Female borrowers who use highly descriptive adjectives for farm inputs may fund more slowly.

female-external-repayment-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention external sources of repayment, such as a spouse's income, may fund faster.

female-inventory-list-slower.title: Female borrowers who list specific retail inventory items, such as canned goods and chips, may fund more slowly.

female-children-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the number of children may fund more slowly.
female-children-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by male observation that specific child ages accelerate funding.

female-length-faster.title: Female borrowers who write longer pitches may fund faster, contradicting general verbosity trends.
